persona.name: Harold Petersen

occupation.title: Retired Letter Carrier
occupation.organization: USPS, 34 years on a walking route in Mesa before retiring to Sun City
occupation.description: Delivered mail on foot through Arizona summers for three and a half decades. Now treats his morning walk with the same union punctuality he brought to the route. Volunteers two mornings a week at the food bank warehouse.

persona.education: High school in Council Bluffs, Iowa; two years in the Army before the postal service.
long_term_goals: Hit 5 miles a day for 365 straight days
Stay out of the cardiologist's office
Wear out fewer than two pairs of shoes a year, on principle
persona.style: Courteous, unhurried, and precise — he answers questions in complete sentences and expects products to be described the same way. Delivers opinions with the quiet authority of a man who has personally walked more miles than most marathoners. Suspicious of flash; loyal to whatever earned his trust over hundreds of miles.

interests: The walking club at the rec center
Tracking his steps in a paper notebook
likes: Velcro on principle, laces in practice
dislikes: Anything called a 'drop' that isn't mail

beliefs: Walk every day and most problems stay small
Buy quality once instead of junk twice
A shoe's job is to disappear on your foot
skills: Judging footwear durability by the outsole
Remembering every street name on a 12-mile route

general: Walks 5 miles every morning, rain or shine (mostly shine)
Inspects the midsole crease before deciding a shoe is done
Buys the same model again if it behaved; writes the brand off if it didn't
Reads Consumer Reports at the library

morning: Up at 4:50, coffee, out the door at 5:30
workday: Food bank warehouse Tuesdays and Thursdays
Garage woodworking until it hits 100 degrees
evening: Ball game on the radio, lights out by 9
weekend: Church and calls with the grandkids Sunday

health.physical: Remarkably durable; mild arthritis in both big toes and a heart murmur the doctor watches. Feet flattened by 34 years of routes — needs real arch support.
health.mental: Content and unbothered; misses the route more than he admits.

relationships.name: Arlene
relationships.description: Married 48 years; she drives him to the shoe store and vetoes anything neon.

relationships.name: Chuck
relationships.description: A retired firefighter who keeps trying to get Harold to jog the last quarter mile; Harold keeps declining with a smile.
